records.excerpt: Official Natural England FeatureServer identifies the National Nature Reserves (England) polygon layer, supports JSON queries, and states that the data excludes proposed sites.
records.web_line_scope: FeatureServer service description, layer listing, supported query format and copyright statement
records.record_scope: official service identity, query capability and designation scope

records.excerpt: Official layer metadata reports an esriGeometryPolygon layer with objectIdField OBJECTID and published fields HYPERLINK, OBJECTID, REF_CODE, NAME, MEASURE, LABEL, GlobalID, Shape__Area and Shape__Length.
records.web_line_scope: layer name, geometry type, object ID field, published field definitions and query capabilities
records.record_scope: official layer schema and bounded selectable field set

records.excerpt: Natural England publishes the National Nature Reserves dataset, last updated 29 April 2026, with no public access constraints, a 15 April 2026 revision date and Open Government Licence information.
records.web_line_scope: publisher, last updated date, dataset summary, data links, access constraints, revision date and licence section
records.record_scope: official dataset provenance, update date, access boundary and licence

records.excerpt: Defra Data Services lists the National Nature Reserves ESRI REST Feature Service API, WMS, WFS, OGC API and full-download resources, identifies Natural England as publisher and records the 15 April 2026 revision date.
records.web_line_scope: data services, publisher, contact and dataset reference dates
records.record_scope: official Defra distribution routes and revision provenance

records.excerpt: Natural England guidance states that where possible its geographic data is published under the Open Government Licence, which permits commercial and non-commercial reuse with source acknowledgement, and directs users to the Open Data Geoportal and Data.GOV.UK.
records.web_line_scope: open data and copyright section plus download maps and data section
records.record_scope: official access, reuse and attribution boundary
